Frequently Asked Questions

What is Cliza?

Cliza is an account on X (Twitter) that launches coins for you on the Base blockchain for free.

How is it free?

Since Base is an efficient L2, the gas fees are very affordable for us. These costs can easily be subsidised from those coins that do a sizable amount of volume.

How do you make fees as a launch protocol / platform?

The Uniswap V3 liquidity pool that we set up for the user charges a 1% fee for every trade. Out of that 1%, we keep 20% for operations and 80% is for the users to claim.

Where does the liquidity come from?

We use a single sided liquidity pool on Uniswap V3 with tick size settings that does not require us to provide any ETH or wETH.

Are you live?

Yes!
